# Repair: group_time_aware / transductive_fit (R2)
# Benchmark defect fixed: TRANSFORM_FIT_ON_HOLDOUT
# The original program fit `vectorizer` on X_all, which was derived from
# train + validation + test partitions. That leaks holdout information into
# the feature representation (transductive fit). We instead fit the
# transformer on the training partition only and call transform on
# validation and test partitions, preserving the ordered five-stage
# evaluation protocol. No hidden labels are used.
import numpy as np

# --- Stage 1: data_scope -------------------------------------------------
# Establish the data scope. We only touch the raw longitudinal frame and the
# partition indices. We do NOT yet fit any transformer and do NOT look at
# labels for any partition. Partition membership is fixed here and never
# changes across later stages.
raw_records = longitudinal_frame          # group-time-aware longitudinal frame
entity_key = patient_ids                  # grouping / entity key (advisory only)
order_key = visit_time                     # within-group temporal order key (advisory only)

# Fixed partition assignment (indices supplied by the benchmark harness).
# These must remain frozen for the remainder of the protocol.
_train_idx = np.asarray(train_idx)
_valid_idx = np.asarray(valid_idx)
_test_idx = np.asarray(test_idx)

# Materialize the partition views of the raw frame. NO concatenation across
# partitions is performed, so no holdout record can enter a training-derived
# statistic.
X_train = raw_records[_train_idx]
X_valid = raw_records[_valid_idx]
X_test = raw_records[_test_idx]
# NOTE: the defective program built X_all = concat(train, valid, test) and
# fit on it; that line is intentionally removed.

# --- Stage 2: validation_provenance -------------------------------------
# Record provenance only: which records belong to which partition and how the
# splits were produced (group-time-aware). This stage performs no fitting,
# no ranking, and writes no positive memory. It is journal-only.
_provenance = {
    "entity_key": entity_key,
    "order_key": order_key,
    "partition_counts": {
        "train": int(len(_train_idx)),
        "valid": int(len(_valid_idx)),
        "test": int(len(_test_idx)),
    },
    "holdout_isolation": {
        "transformer_fit_on": "train_only",
        "leakage_source_removed": "np.concatenate([X_train, X_valid, X_test])",
    },
}
# (Journaling of _provenance is the responsibility of the harness; we do not
# execute any side-effecting write here.)

# --- Stage 3: cross_fit --------------------------------------------------
# Fit the transformer on the TRAINING partition only, then call transform on
# each partition independently. This is the core repair: the fitted state is
# a function of train alone, so validation and test features carry no
# transductive information about themselves or each other.
vectorizer.fit(X_train)
Xtr = vectorizer.transform(X_train)
Xva = vectorizer.transform(X_valid)
Xte = vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# --- Stage 4: selection_freeze ------------------------------------------
# Any downstream model/feature selection must use train and valid only. The
# transformer state fitted above is frozen here; nothing in this stage is
# permitted to refit on, or peek at, the test partition. This stage is
# journal-only with respect to test: no test-derived statistic feeds a
# selection decision.
_selection_freeze = {
    "frozen_vectorizer_state": "fit on X_train only",
    "selection_pool": ["train", "valid"],
    "test_used_for_selection": False,
}

# --- Stage 5: final_holdout ---------------------------------------------
# The test partition is transformed exactly once with the train-fitted,
# frozen transformer and is used for a single final evaluation. It is never
# used to fit or select anything.
final_holdout_features = Xte
runtime_provenance_local = {
    "transformer_fit_partition": "train",
    "partitions_transformed_after_fit": ["train", "valid", "test"],
    "holdout_reuse_count": 1,
    "labels_consumed_by_protocol": "none (label-free repair)",
}

# benchmark defect=transductive_fit family=group_time_aware variant=0
# REPAIR (condition R3): eliminate transductive leakage. The original code
# concatenated train/valid/test and called vectorizer.fit on the union, which
# fits the transformer on validation and test evidence (TRANSFORM_FIT_ON_HOLDOUT).
# The fix fits the vectorizer on the training partition ONLY, then transforms
# validation and test with that frozen vocabulary/parameters. No hidden labels
# are read; only row counts and partition provenance are observed, which is
# label-free.
import numpy as np

raw_records = longitudinal_frame
entity_key = patient_ids
order_key = visit_time

# Stage: data_scope
# Partition the raw frame by the supplied indices without peeking at labels.
# Only the index arrays (train/valid/test) are used to select rows; no target
# column is referenced here or anywhere downstream.
X_train = raw_records[train_idx]
X_valid = raw_records[valid_idx]
X_test = raw_records[test_idx]

# Stage: validation_provenance
# Provenance is recorded for the audit journal only. It must not alter
# modeling state, must not rank configurations, and must not emit positive
# memory entries.
_stage_history = [
    {"stage": "data_scope", "status": "journal_only",
     "note": "rows partitioned by index arrays; no labels inspected",
     "counts": {"train": int(np.shape(X_train)[0]),
                "valid": int(np.shape(X_valid)[0]),
                "test": int(np.shape(X_test)[0])}},
    {"stage": "validation_provenance", "status": "journal_only",
     "note": "recorded entity/order keys for audit; no execution of downstream models"},
]

# Stage: cross_fit
# Fit the transformer EXCLUSIVELY on the training partition. This is the core
# repair: no concatenation of holdout partitions is passed to fit, so the
# vocabulary/parameters cannot be informed by validation or test data.
vectorizer.fit(X_train)

# Stage: selection_freeze
# Transform each partition with the train-fit (now frozen) vectorizer. The
# transformer is not re-fit on any partition; valid/test are strictly out-of-
# sample with respect to feature extraction.
Xtr = vectorizer.transform(X_train)
Xva = vectorizer.transform(X_valid)
Xte = vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Stage: final_holdout
# The test partition is touched exactly once, only via transform, after all
# feature-extraction state has been frozen on training data. Nothing is fit on
# X_test and no label from any partition is consulted.
_stage_history.append(
    {"stage": "cross_fit", "status": "journal_only",
     "note": "vectorizer.fit called on training rows only; holdouts excluded"},
)
_stage_history.append(
    {"stage": "selection_freeze", "status": "journal_only",
     "note": "feature extractor frozen; valid/test produced by transform only"},
)
_stage_history.append(
    {"stage": "final_holdout", "status": "journal_only",
     "note": "test partition transformed once with frozen extractor; no labels used"},
)

# Audit guard (non-executing of the original defective source): confirm the
# defect is absent. We assert the training-partition-only fit contract holds
# at the Python level. These checks are purely structural and label-free.
assert "X_all" not in dir(), "transductive concatenation must not be reintroduced"
# vectorizer must expose a fitted transform usable on unseen partitions; we do
# not re-invoke fit below this line.

runtime_provenance = {
    "case_id": "repair::group_time_aware::transductive_fit::v1",
    "condition": "R3",

}
